targets.rawSql: WITH samples AS (SELECT timestamp, weight_kg AS value FROM body_composition WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL), trends AS (SELECT timestamp AS time, 'Raw' AS metric, value FROM samples UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, '7-day average', AVG(value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM samples UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, '28-day average', AVG(value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '28 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM samples), monthly AS (SELECT time_bucket('1 month', timestamp) AS time, 'Monthly average' AS metric, AVG(value) AS value FROM samples GROUP BY 1) SELECT time, metric, value FROM trends UNION ALL SELECT time, metric, value FROM monthly ORDER BY time
